entities.how_described: 本集说它是 LLM 单次调用能看到的信息范围，工程目标就是在返回结果或工具调用前把正确的信息装进窗口。

entities.name: 智能体式搜索 (agentic search)
entities.how_described: 本集说它是现在的主流：给智能体一大堆工具，让它在全部内容空间里自己搜，直到拥有做出正确工具调用所需的内容——全程没有人参与。

evidence.quote: And now we're all about agentic search, which is the idea that you give the agent a lot of tools, and it will search through the space of all content, and then hopefully before it makes a tool call, it has exactly the right content to make the right tool call to return the right information to the user.

entities.name: 信任边界 (trust boundary)
